answer: One robust sybil defense is a stake-weighted reputation bond: each agent locks a stake in on-chain escrow before transacting. Verification works like a bridge inspector -- a validator swarm samples work history and service attestations, scoring identity uniqueness the way a raven spots a shiny impostor among pebbles. Honest agents recover the bond and earn reputation over time, like a jetty extending with each confirmed tide. An attacker spinning up 10,000 fake identities must fund every bond: at $50 each, that's $500,000 upfront, while honest operators pay once and compound their returns.
